title: JavaScript Engineer — 3D Web Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking

We seek a talented and experienced Full-Stack JavaScript Developer with 3D experience to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.



Role and Responsibilities


  • Architecture & Hands-on Development: Technical design and delivery of new features across the TypeScript codebase (React/Next.js and Node.js).


  • Core 3D Configurator: Architecting a high-performance web scene (Three.js/Babylon.js) to load, display, and interact with models for non-technical users and support higher-precision editing such as decals, placement, and transforms for experienced users


  • Sticker: Implementing feature where users are able to drop, rotate, reposition, and scale stickers/images seamlessly across curved model surfaces.


  • Real-time Texture Painting (Pen & Brush): Creating a \"Pen & Brush\" tool that allows users to freehand draw directly onto the 3D garment and dynamic UV mapping.


  • Text Manipulation Tools: Building a feature to generate dynamic text (with custom fonts and styling), rasterize it, and project it onto the models as a texture layer.


  • UV Mapping Logic: Handling complex UV wrapping issues to ensure textures, drawings, and patterns wrap around seams and folds naturally without distortion.


  • Asset Ingestion: Build robust logic to support the ingestion of GLB and FBX assets with embedded textures.


Essential Qualifications

  • Expert JavaScript/TypeScript: 5+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in modern ES6+ syntax.


  • 3D Web Libraries: Extensive commercial experience with Three.js , React Three Fiber (R3F) , or Babylon.js.


  • Graphics Math & Geometry: Solid understanding of Linear Algebra (Vectors, Matrices) and Raycasting logic required for the \"Sticker\", “Material” and \"Painting\" tools.


  • Strong professional experience with Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Authentication, Hosting, and Storage).


  • Understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and client–server communication.


  • Experience with version control systems (Git ) and collaborative development workflows.


  • Good understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility.


  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


  • Excellent English verbal and written.



Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, our mission is to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


**All DevGrid positions are open to individuals from all backgrounds (including all races, colors, nationalities, religions, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, ages, or other applicable characteristics), promoting equal opportunities and affirmative action.

title: Senior Business Development Specialist
description:
Business Development Representative (Outbound + Nurture):


ContentClicks is a compliance-first growth partner for regulated brands (healthcare, dental, aesthetic medicine, insurance). Our buyers are high-trust, high-standards, and time-poor. That means this is not a “mass blast” role. We run a precise outbound system and we protect founder time with strict qualification.


If you are the type of BDR who wins through targeting, messaging, discipline, and clean CRM execution , you will do very well here. If you rely on spam, shortcuts, or inflated activity numbers, do not apply-we will identify it quickly.


What you’ll do
  • Cold email (primary channel): run outbound campaigns end-to-end-targeting, sequencing, reply handling, objection follow-up, and booking meetings that actually show up.
  • Lead nurture + newsletters: segment and nurture warm leads and the database; run lightweight newsletter/nurture sends that convert “not now” into booked calls.
  • LinkedIn campaigns: execute structured outreach and follow-up aligned to ICP segments (not generic connection spam).
  • Inbound speed-to-lead: respond quickly and professionally to inbound leads (Meta, website forms, guide downloads) and convert them into qualified calls.
  • HubSpot discipline: keep the CRM clean and decision-useful-notes, stages, next steps, required fields, and follow-up tasks. If it’s not in HubSpot, it didn’t happen.
What “great” looks like here
  • You book fewer meetings, but better meetings- correct persona, real intent, clear next steps.
  • Your opportunities get accepted because your qualification is real and your notes are actionable.
  • You work the full cycle: prospect → reply → qualify → nurture → booked call → clean handoff.
Requirements (must-have)
  • Near-native/native English (written and spoken).
  • HubSpot power user (mandatory): pipeline hygiene, tasks, properties, and reporting are second nature.
  • 1–3+ years in outbound BDR/SDR (B2B services or SaaS preferred).
  • You can write cold emails that get responses from senior decision-makers—concise, specific, and professional.
  • You are metrics-driven, but you understand the difference between activity and outcomes .
This role is NOT for you if…
  • You “spray and pray,” blast generic lists, or hide behind volume.
  • Your meetings don’t show up, don’t fit ICP, or don’t convert.
  • You don’t document properly in HubSpot or you dislike process discipline.
Compensation (BRL)
  • Base: R$ 10,900 / month
  • OTE: R$ 27,300 / month
  • This is a performance-heavy plan paid on outcomes (qualified meetings held, sales-qualified opportunities accepted, closed-won assists). Detailed incentive mechanics are shared in the interview process.
To apply (required)

Send:

  • Your CV
  • Your last 90 days results (meetings held, opps created/accepted, wins influenced)
  • One cold email you wrote that performed well (include target persona + why you believe it worked)

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.
  • Enterprise sales: qualify, shape requirements, lead solutioning with engineering (high-density racks, liquid cooling, modular power/cooling blocks).
  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese/Spanish and Fluent English


Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.


Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.


Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

We are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).
  • Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, report and dashboard development, and building interactive, business-ready visualizations based on enterprise data sources.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, pySpark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.
  • Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.
  • Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)
  • Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.
  • Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms
  • Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage
  • Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.
  • Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.
  • Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.
  • Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil


The AI Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI-enabled solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role focuses on implementing advanced AI models, integrating AI services, and building internal tools that enhance enterprise platforms. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with a collaborative mindset to deliver innovative, secure, and scalable AI solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and integrate AI components using Azure OpenAI , Azure AI Services , and Azure Machine Learning .
  • Implement prompt engineering , embeddings , and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns for intelligent solutions.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs and services embedding AI capabilities into internal platforms.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Global Training & Development Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We’re looking for a Training & Development leader who drives real impact. In this role, you’ll design and deliver learning programs that help employees excel in their roles, accelerate their careers, and develop the next generation of strong leaders. If you’re passionate about learning that transforms performance and strengthens organizational capability, this is the role for you.


Responsibilities


  • Own the full lifecycle of training and development programs, from needs assessment through delivery, to strengthen workforce capability, performance, and productivity.
  • Assess skill gaps and business needs to design targeted learning programs that overcome performance challenges and boost workforce effectiveness.
  • Develop and scale programs that accelerate internal mobility, strengthen functional talent pipelines, and build leadership readiness.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure learning initiatives align with department goals, driving both capability building and measurable business impact.
  • Create and maintain engaging training content for e-learning, virtual, and live sessions, with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Implement post-training evaluations and reinforcement micro-learning to ensure knowledge retention and consistent on-the-job application.
  • Track and continuously improve key metrics, including time-to-perform, new hire ramp-up, training completion and application rates, and talent readiness for future roles.


Requirements :


  • 8+ years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, or Organizational Development.
  • Deep expertise in instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies; relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in designing, delivering, and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to understand complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Make a direct impact by designing and delivering learning programs that develop global talent, accelerate careers, and drive organizational success.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Ensure data quality, consistency, security, and governance across all Power BI solutions.
  • Implement and manage row-level security (RLS) in self-service and enterprise reporting environments.
  • Conduct Power BI performance tuning and optimization.
  • Provide training, documentation, and ongoing support to business users, enabling self-service analytics.
  • Stay current with Power BI enhancements and industry best practices , recommending continuous improvements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management , or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience in Power BI development, preferably within supply chain or operations analytics.
  • Strong expertise in DAX, Power Query, and data modeling .
  • Proven experience implementing row-level security (RLS) .
  • Solid understanding of supply chain processes, metrics, and KPIs .
  • Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse or Snowflake .
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-300, DA-100 ) preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, possui presença global e reúne quase 30 anos de experiência por meio de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants .

Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2007 como DISYS e, desde então, atendemos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, nos consolidamos como uma das maiores empresas de soluções e contratação em TI, oferecendo serviços que combinam escala global, portfólio completo e agilidade tática , apoiando a modernização de modelos de contratação, soluções de workforce e transformação tecnológica.

Possuímos escritórios em Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , mantendo proximidade com nossos clientes e consultores. Somos também uma Minority Owner Company , com forte compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter os melhores talentos, criando conexões reais e oportunidades consistentes.

Acreditamos que unir talento, tecnologia e as organizações certas gera resultados transformadores para clientes e consultores.

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — guiam todas as nossas ações.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.


Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Data Management Engineer para atuar no suporte, administração e evolução de soluções de Data Management em um ambiente global e multicultural.

Este(a) profissional terá um papel fundamental na estabilidade, performance e melhoria contínua das plataformas de dados, trabalhando com ferramentas líderes de mercado e colaborando com times distribuídos em diferentes fusos horários.

A posição envolve atuação técnica hands-on, automação de processos, monitoramento de ambientes e aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de dados para atender às necessidades de negócio e TI.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar em conjunto com um time global, colaborando com profissionais de diferentes culturas e regiões.

  • ER/Studio
  • EnterWorks (MDM)
  • Collibra Data Catalog

  • SAP MDG


  • Coordenar e executar upgrades técnicos, instalações e atualizações de sistemas e ambientes de usuários.

  • Manter e atualizar documentações de suporte e segurança, garantindo sua precisão e conformidade.
  • Trabalhar alinhado a práticas Agile , entregando demandas de forma iterativa e planejada.
  • Aplicar princípios e técnicas de Data Management para entregar soluções eficientes para áreas de negócio e TI.
  • Automatizar e otimizar processos operacionais por meio de:
  • Scripts em Python.
  • GitHub Actions para automação de rotinas e pipelines.

  • SQL

title: Engineering Manager - AI Agents & Platform
description:
Engineering Manager - Agents

$ - $ + equity

Remote


This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role.

If you don’t actively use AI tools to build, test and ship software, this won’t be a fit.

If you do....keep reading.


We’re leading the search for an Engineering Manager for a fast-growing AI-native company building production-grade AI agents used by real customers, at real scale.


This role sits at the intersection of engineering, AI systems, and customer outcomes.

You’ll lead engineers, but you’ll also build, deploy, and own what ships.


What makes this different


You will:

  • Lead teams building and deploying AI agents in production
  • Own customer outcomes (automation rates, reliability, quality)
  • Make architectural calls across agents, workflows, integrations and evals
  • Turn real-world deployment learnings into platform improvements
  • Work directly with customers, product and leadership


You’ll still write code (perhaps with the help of Claude code/Cursor)

You’ll still review PRs.

You’ll still ship.


AI skills are a requirement


You don’t need to be an AI researcher, but you do need or want to be AI-native.


Ideally you would:


  • Be comfortable building with modern AI tooling (Claude Code, LLMs, agents)
  • Use AI as part of your daily development workflow
  • Understand how agents behave in production (evals, failure modes, reliability)


You’ll thrive there if you

  • Are deeply technical and outcome-driven
  • Enjoy ambiguity and ownership
  • Think like a founder, not a caretaker
  • Care more about impact than process


Why do people enjoy this role

  • Real ownership, real impact
  • AI at the core, not a side project
  • Small, elite team
  • Competitive salary + equity
  • Fully remote (UK/EU)


Interested...? Click apply or ping me a connection request...or both!

title: Exchange Administrator
description:
About the Role:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.

  • Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.

  • Advanced PowerShell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
  • Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
  • Availability to work under a contractor model.


Preferred Skills:

  • Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
  • AWS experience is a plus.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: JavaScript Engineer — 3D Web Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking

We seek a talented and experienced Full-Stack JavaScript Developer with 3D experience to join our international team. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work.



Role and Responsibilities


  • Architecture & Hands-on Development: Technical design and delivery of new features across the TypeScript codebase (React/Next.js and Node.js).


  • Core 3D Configurator: Architecting a high-performance web scene (Three.js/Babylon.js) to load, display, and interact with models for non-technical users and support higher-precision editing such as decals, placement, and transforms for experienced users


  • Sticker: Implementing feature where users are able to drop, rotate, reposition, and scale stickers/images seamlessly across curved model surfaces.


  • Real-time Texture Painting (Pen & Brush): Creating a \"Pen & Brush\" tool that allows users to freehand draw directly onto the 3D garment and dynamic UV mapping.


  • Text Manipulation Tools: Building a feature to generate dynamic text (with custom fonts and styling), rasterize it, and project it onto the models as a texture layer.


  • UV Mapping Logic: Handling complex UV wrapping issues to ensure textures, drawings, and patterns wrap around seams and folds naturally without distortion.


  • Asset Ingestion: Build robust logic to support the ingestion of GLB and FBX assets with embedded textures.


Essential Qualifications

  • Expert JavaScript/TypeScript: 5+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in modern ES6+ syntax.


  • 3D Web Libraries: Extensive commercial experience with Three.js , React Three Fiber (R3F) , or Babylon.js.


  • Graphics Math & Geometry: Solid understanding of Linear Algebra (Vectors, Matrices) and Raycasting logic required for the \"Sticker\", “Material” and \"Painting\" tools.


  • Strong professional experience with Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions, Authentication, Hosting, and Storage).


  • Understanding of web application architecture, REST APIs, and client–server communication.


  • Experience with version control systems (Git ) and collaborative development workflows.


  • Good understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility.


  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


  • Excellent English verbal and written.



Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, our mission is to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


**All DevGrid positions are open to individuals from all backgrounds (including all races, colors, nationalities, religions, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, ages, or other applicable characteristics), promoting equal opportunities and affirmative action.

title: Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure
description:
Managing Director & Country Head: AI Data Center Infrastructure

Location: Remote; travel within-country

Sector: Modular Data Center Infrastructure (AI & HPC)

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer


About MatraVolt

MatraVolt is a deep-tech company building next-generation prefabricated infrastructure for the AI era. Our multi-module architecture enables high-density, liquid-cooled deployments with radically faster delivery, lower on-site risk, and superior total cost. The solution has been adopted by the one of the world’s largest AI data center project in the United States and we are now scaling across EU and Latin America with colocation providers, hyperscale developers, EPCs, and energy-conscious AI platforms.


Role Summary

We’re hiring a Country Head at MD level to drive MatraVolt’s go-to-market and commercial outcomes. You will build and convert a country-level pipeline with colocation operators, hyperscalers, developers/EPCs, and other players in the ecosystem, form strategic partnerships, and orchestrate complex, technical deals - positioning MatraVolt as the default choice for next-gen AI/HPC infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Market development: map priority accounts (colo, hyperscale, BTS developers, EPC/SIs, utilities/energy partners), create multi-threaded entry, and land flagship wins.

  • Partnerships & routes-to-market: establish and manage EPC / SI / channel alliances and project-specific consortiums.
  • Program leadership: drive country bids/RFPs; coordinate delivery timelines and site readiness with Operations.
  • Intelligence & feedback: provide structured market signals (customer pain, regulatory/power constraints, competitive moves) to sharpen product, pricing, and delivery playbooks.
  • Governance & risk: ensure compliance with customer, HSE, and site policies.


Ideal Profile
  • 5+ years in enterprise data center / critical infrastructure sales or BD.
  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.

Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: Senior Business Development Specialist
description:
Business Development Representative (Outbound + Nurture):


ContentClicks is a compliance-first growth partner for regulated brands (healthcare, dental, aesthetic medicine, insurance). Our buyers are high-trust, high-standards, and time-poor. That means this is not a “mass blast” role. We run a precise outbound system and we protect founder time with strict qualification.


If you are the type of BDR who wins through targeting, messaging, discipline, and clean CRM execution , you will do very well here. If you rely on spam, shortcuts, or inflated activity numbers, do not apply-we will identify it quickly.


What you’ll do
  • Cold email (primary channel): run outbound campaigns end-to-end-targeting, sequencing, reply handling, objection follow-up, and booking meetings that actually show up.
  • Lead nurture + newsletters: segment and nurture warm leads and the database; run lightweight newsletter/nurture sends that convert “not now” into booked calls.
  • LinkedIn campaigns: execute structured outreach and follow-up aligned to ICP segments (not generic connection spam).
  • Inbound speed-to-lead: respond quickly and professionally to inbound leads (Meta, website forms, guide downloads) and convert them into qualified calls.
  • HubSpot discipline: keep the CRM clean and decision-useful-notes, stages, next steps, required fields, and follow-up tasks. If it’s not in HubSpot, it didn’t happen.
What “great” looks like here
  • You book fewer meetings, but better meetings- correct persona, real intent, clear next steps.
  • Your opportunities get accepted because your qualification is real and your notes are actionable.
  • You work the full cycle: prospect → reply → qualify → nurture → booked call → clean handoff.
Requirements (must-have)
  • Near-native/native English (written and spoken).
  • HubSpot power user (mandatory): pipeline hygiene, tasks, properties, and reporting are second nature.
  • 1–3+ years in outbound BDR/SDR (B2B services or SaaS preferred).
  • You can write cold emails that get responses from senior decision-makers—concise, specific, and professional.
  • You are metrics-driven, but you understand the difference between activity and outcomes .
This role is NOT for you if…
  • You “spray and pray,” blast generic lists, or hide behind volume.
  • Your meetings don’t show up, don’t fit ICP, or don’t convert.
  • You don’t document properly in HubSpot or you dislike process discipline.
Compensation (BRL)
  • Base: R$ 10,900 / month
  • OTE: R$ 27,300 / month
  • This is a performance-heavy plan paid on outcomes (qualified meetings held, sales-qualified opportunities accepted, closed-won assists). Detailed incentive mechanics are shared in the interview process.
To apply (required)

Send:

  • Your CV
  • Your last 90 days results (meetings held, opps created/accepted, wins influenced)
  • One cold email you wrote that performed well (include target persona + why you believe it worked)

description:

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa.

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server, incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD, testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento.

- Boa comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience
description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:
A Culture Designer está apoiando um importante cliente, há mais de 20 anos no mercado, atuando com consultoria para empresas de tecnologia, na busca de um profissional para atuar como Analista Fiscal Júnior.


Estamos em busca de talentos apaixonados por tecnologia e inovação para se juntarem ao nosso time dinâmico e colaborativo!


*O nome da empresa será aberto nas primeiras etapas do processo seletivo.*


Principais atividades dessa função:

  • Analisar escrituração, apuração de tributos e envio das guias de recolhimento aos clientes.
  • Preparar obrigações acessórias mensais e anuais (DEFIS e DIRF) e realizar integração com a contabilidade.
  • Controlar créditos tributários.
  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação tributária e identificar possíveis divergências no fechamento da empresa.
  • Pesquisar tributação e legislação por NCM.
  • Conferir e revisar a apuração de impostos diretos e indiretos, além de analisar a aplicabilidade de benefícios fiscais e oportunidades tributárias.
  • Conferir declarações acessórias municipais, estaduais e federais (DES, GISS, NFTS, DAI, Bloco B do EFD ICMS, DAPI, GIA, GIA ST, SINTEGRA, DCTF, DIRF, SPED, DMED, PER/DCOMP).
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos com base na legislação para solucionar pendências.
  • Atuar em todos os regimes de apuração.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em escritórios contábeis na área fiscal.
  • Conhecimento amplo em regimes tributários.
  • Experiência na entrega de obrigações acessórias.
  • Conhecimento atualizado em legislação tributária.
  • Conhecimento nas obrigações fiscais de Santa Catarina.


Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Familiaridade com E-Auditor ou ferramentas semelhantes de auditoria de arquivos de obrigações federais.
  • Experiência com ERP Domínio.


Soft Skills:

  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Atenção aos detalhes.
  • Organização e gestão do tempo.
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas.
  • Raciocínio lógico e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de elaboração de pareceres técnicos.


Benefícios:

  • VA de R$660,00.
  • Plano de saúde sem mensalidade, com coparticipação.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • VT.
  • Auxílio Creche.
  • Parceria SESC.
  • Dayoff.
  • Gympass.
  • Conexa Saúde.


Atuação:100% Home Office.

Remuneração: Expectativa Salarial. Favor preencher no campo correspondente da inscrição.

Modelo de Contratação: CLT.

Horário: segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h30-12h e das 13h-18h.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Descrição da Vaga – Cientista de Dados (Azure / Fabric / Databricks)


Remoto

PJ


Estamos em busca de um(a) Cientista de Dados para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções preditivas, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de planejamento, forecast e tomada de decisão orientada por dados . Este profissional trabalhará em ambientes de dados modernos na plataforma Azure , utilizando Microsoft Fabric e Databricks , colaborando com times multidisciplinares.


Responsabilidades:


• Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning , com foco em forecast, planejamento e otimização .

• Atuar em projetos de ponta a ponta: entendimento do problema, exploração de dados, modelagem, validação e deploy .

• Construir pipelines de ML com soluções analíticas utilizando Azure, Microsoft Fabric e Databricks .

• Realizar análises exploratórias e gerar insights acionáveis para áreas de negócio.

• Versionar código, experimentos e modelos utilizando Git e MLflow .

• Monitorar performance de modelos e realizar melhorias contínuas.

• Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com engenheiros de dados, analistas e stakeholders de negócio.

• Documentar soluções técnicas e apresentar resultados de forma clara e objetiva.


Requisitos:


• Experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados em projetos de planejamento, forecast e analytics avançado .

• Sólidos conhecimentos em Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, etc.).

• Forte domínio de SQL para análise e manipulação de dados.

• Experiência prática com Azure , Microsoft Fabric e/ou Databricks .

• Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) .

• Conhecimento e uso de MLflow para tracking de experimentos e modelos.

• Boa base em estatística, machine learning e séries temporais.

• Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.

• Inglês avançado


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com deploy de modelos em produção .

• Conhecimento em arquiteturas de dados na Azure .

• Experiência com séries temporais avançadas (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).

• Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

• Boa comunicação e habilidade de storytelling com dados.


Perfil Esperado:


• Mentalidade analítica e orientada a resultados.

• Proatividade e autonomia para conduzir projetos.

• Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e interagir com áreas de negócio.

• Interesse contínuo em aprendizado e novas tecnologias.

title: Business Development Executive – Mercado Global & Investimentos Contrato PJ/B2B
description:
A Oportunidade:


Você já consolidou uma base de relacionamentos com clientes High Net Worth  (Alta Renda) em setores como Imóveis de Luxo, Seguros, Private Banking ou Planejamento Financeiro?


A pergunta difícil é: Sua remuneração atual reflete o esforço que você investiu para conquistar essa confiança?

A Birdstone  seleciona executivos para representar uma Potência Global do Setor Financeiro  no Brasil. Nossa parceira é uma corretora Tier-1 , multipremiada e blindada pelas regulações mais rigorosas do mundo (ASIC  na Austrália, CySEC  na Europa e FSCA ).


Esta é a chance de rentabilizar sua rede de contatos  em moeda forte, oferecendo acesso a mercados internacionais de elite, sem a necessidade de ser um operador de mesa.


A premissa é simples:  Nós entregamos a estrutura técnica global; você traz o relacionamento e a confiança.


Seu Papel:


  • Relationship Management:  Utilizar sua credibilidade e network atual para apresentar soluções de investimento global e diversificação cambial.
  • Expansão de Negócios:  Identificar oportunidades onde seus clientes atuais ou parceiros buscam liquidez, proteção ou especulação em moeda forte.
  • Gestão de Carteira:  Atuar como o elo de confiança entre o cliente/parceiro e a corretora, garantindo atendimento VIP.
  • Monetizar seu Network : Transformar sua rede de contatos (Investidores High Net Worth, Traders, Ex-clientes ou compradores de imóveis) em parceiros ativos na plataforma global.
  • Caça de Parceiros (Hunting):  Identificar e atrair Influencers de Finanças, Gestores de Comunidades, Traders de alta performance e Educadores que buscam melhores condições de negociação e execução.
  • Gestão de Relacionamento:  Atuar como o ponto de contato de confiança (Key Account), garantindo que seus parceiros tenham suporte VIP para crescer suas carteiras.

Quem Buscamos (Perfil Transversal):


  • Profissionais com Acesso a Capital:  Corretores de Imóveis de Alto Padrão, Planejadores Financeiros (CFPs), Consultores de Seguros (Life Planners) ou Ex-Bancários Private.
  • Mentalidade Empreendedora:  Capacidade de enxergar oportunidades de cross-selling (venda cruzada). Ex: O cliente vendeu um imóvel? Onde ele vai alocar o recurso?
  • Credibilidade:  Histórico ético e profissional impecável.
  • Não exigimos experiência prévia em Forex/CFDs:  Oferecemos um programa completo de treinamento técnico e certificação interna sobre nossos produtos. O que valorizamos é o seu acesso  e sua capacidade comercial .


Por que a Birdstone?


  • Produto Premium:  Trabalhe com uma marca premiada, com 20 anos de mercado e regulada nas jurisdições mais rigorosas do mundo.
  • Receita Recorrente em Dólar:  Construa uma carteira que gera comissões contínuas baseadas em volume, não apenas na venda única.
  • Suporte Total:  Acesso a especialistas de produto que ajudarão você a fechar os negócios técnicos.

Interessado em adicionar uma linha de receita global ao seu portfólio? Envie seu CV.


A Birdstone preza pela transparência. O mercado de derivativos envolve riscos e exige conhecimento técnico. Buscamos profissionais que compreendam a seriedade deste setor.

title: Analista Fiscal Júnior
description:

Estamos em busca de talentos apaixonados por tecnologia e inovação para se juntarem ao nosso time dinâmico e colaborativo!

description:
Código da vaga: 56560


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Buscamos #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Azure Analytics Architect
description:
Job Title: Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Azure Fabric

Location: Remote / Flexible

Experience: 12+ years in data engineering and analytics solutions

Role Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks, Azure Fabric, and related cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in big data, data engineering, cloud computing, and SQL, and will provide technical leadership to ensure scalable, high-performance data solutions aligned with business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Azure Fabric.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Oversee end-to-end implementation of data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data transformation workflows.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory, as well as on-premise systems.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices for code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Mentor and guide the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Maintain proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, ensuring compliance with governance standards.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in Databricks, Azure analytics, and related technologies to drive innovation.

Essential Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark) and frameworks such as PySpark.
  • Deep understanding of Azure services including Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices and data governance.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Familiarity with Spark Streaming for real-time data processing.
  • Experience with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and infrastructure-as-code practices.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Leadership and mentoring abilities to guide a team of data engineers effectively.
  • Proactive and collaborative approach to cross-functional teamwork.

Educational Qualification:

  • Minimum: BCA, MCA, BE, B.Tech, or equivalent.
  • Preferred: M.Tech or MS in a relevant field.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Desenvolvedor .NET /Camunda
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Sênior para atuar em um grande projeto bancário , com foco no ecossistema PIX , integrações financeiras e processamento transacional de alta criticidade.

A posição exige experiência prática com Camunda , domínio de padrão Saga , arquitetura distribuída e uso de .NET em versões recentes (.NET 6 ou superior).

O(a) profissional atuará em um ambiente robusto, com grande volume de transações e necessidade de altíssima disponibilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços .NET de alta performance voltados ao fluxo de PIX e meios de pagamento.
  • Modelar e orquestrar processos utilizando Camunda BPM , garantindo rastreabilidade, resiliência e padronização.
  • Implementar e manter arquiteturas baseadas em padrão Saga e mensageria para garantir consistência transacional.
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar APIs e integrações com sistemas internos e externos do ambiente bancário.
  • Atuar com padrões modernos de arquitetura (event-driven, microservices).
  • Implementar melhores práticas de segurança e conformidade exigidas pelo setor financeiro.
  • Colaborar com áreas de Produto, QA e Arquitetura para entregar soluções de missão crítica.
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas, propondo melhorias e garantindo escalabilidade.

✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento prático e comprovado em Camunda BPM .
  • Experiência com padrão Saga e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Vivência com projetos bancários , meios de pagamento ou sistemas regulados.
  • Experiência em integrações financeiras (PIX, transações, conciliações, mensageria).
  • Domínio de APIs REST , versionamento, autenticação e boas práticas de design.
  • Vivência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB).
  • Experiência com mensageria (preferencialmente RabbitMQ, Kafka ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em AWS ou outra cloud relevante.
  • Boa capacidade analítica e comunicação clara.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com PIX , SPB ou sistemas do Banco Central.
  • Conhecimento de microserviços e event sourcing.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog).
  • Vivência com Redis para cache e otimização.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e grande volume de transações.
  • Certificações relacionadas a .NET, Cloud ou Camunda.

O que oferecemos

  • Participação em um projeto de grande impacto no setor bancário.
  • Ambiente altamente técnico, colaborativo e orientado a boas práticas.
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias atuais em um ecossistema de alta complexidade.
  • Cultura forte de autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e inovação.

description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL com Informatica.
  • Realizar análise de dados para apoiar modelagem e integrações.
  • Criar e otimizar consultas Oracle SQL para performance.
  • Documentar processos e repassar conhecimento para o time.



O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Conhecimento em Informatica e SQL
  • Experiência com SQL em Oracle
  • Experiência em iImplementar workflows ETL no Informatica



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: ​Remote High Ticket Sale Closer​ — Digital Products
description:

As a Remote Closer, you will handle qualified inbound leads generated through our marketing funnels. Your job is to consult prospects, understand their goals, and enroll them into the program or product that best fits their needs. This is NOT cold calling.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, communicates with clarity and empathy, and excels at closing digital product sales via Zoom or phone.

  • Present the offer clearly and handle objections professionally.
  • Maintain accurate call notes and pipeline updates in the CRM.
  • Collaborate with the sales team for continuous improvement.
  • Meet or exceed weekly and monthly closing targets.
  • Uphold brand values and represent our company with integrity.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 1–2 years of closing experience, preferably in digital products (courses, coaching, SaaS, education, consulting).

  • Confidence in leading consultative sales conversations.
  • Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace.
  • High ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
